data.statement: Fix the Text Cleanup AI Clean button remaining disabled when the optional-instructions dialog is cancelled, and make the selectable AI spacing controls usable at the running desktop window size.

acceptance: Cancelling optional AI Cleanup instructions leaves AI-Assisted Cleanup immediately enabled when its normal prerequisites still hold; the default desktop layout no longer compresses or clips spacing controls while retaining multi-select access to Heading, Separator, Noise, Header, and Footer; Apply Spacing, Edit, and Save remain available; Story remains excluded.
data.reason: The fix restores existing action state without starting work or changing saved cleanup data, and the layout change can preserve the same selection semantics through a compact control.
scope: Text Cleanup page/controller cancellation recovery and compact responsive spacing-selector presentation, focused tests, UX requirement update, and affected component documentation. No changes to AI cleanup classification, rendering semantics, or provider calls.
data.source: User report 2026-07-15: cancelling the optional AI Cleanup instructions dialog leaves the AI Clean button disabled; visible spacing checkboxes are cramped at default desktop size.
data.understanding: Restore Text Cleanup action availability after optional-instruction cancellation and rework the AI spacing selector so it remains usable in the default two-preview desktop layout without changing the five selectable categories, default Heading plus Separator selection, or Story exclusion.

data.summary: Red check: cancelling optional AI Cleanup instructions leaves the Text Cleanup page busy and AI-assisted cleanup disabled.
Red check: the default-width spacing selector layout does not exist and the current one-line action row requires 1134 pixels.
AI Cleanup optional-instructions cancellation restores the page action state without starting an operation.
Text Cleanup page keeps the two-row spacing selector and action row usable at default desktop width.

data.rationale: Prevents a cancelled optional prompt from leaving the operator unable to retry the AI Cleanup action.
data.requirement: Cancelling the optional AI Cleanup instructions dialog shall leave the Text Cleanup page ready to start AI-assisted cleanup whenever the normal project, extracted-text, and profile prerequisites still hold; it shall not start, reset, or mutate cleanup state.
data.verification: Focused Text Cleanup controller tests pass in the pinned uv environment.
